scientific_question: Are prespecified Alzheimer pathway polygenic scores associated with later clinical status through prespecified ADNI imaging markers?

cohort.primary_cohort_rule: Use the frozen 691-subject post-imputation cohort and its existing pathway PRS without recomputing scores.
cohort.future_721_subject_analysis: Optional sensitivity analysis only; it is outside this primary protocol and requires a separately frozen protocol.
cohort.external_validation_reason: Case Study 2 is supplementary; independent external validation is reserved for Case Study 1.

row_selection_priority: smallest absolute distance between exact follow-up and 730 days
smallest absolute distance between baseline outcome and imaging

candidate_universe.construction: Cartesian product of 7 frozen pathway scores, 8 primary imaging markers, and 3 clinical outcomes

readiness_gate.family_definition: one imaging marker and one clinical outcome across all seven pathway scores
readiness_gate.family_action_below_minimum: Drop the complete seven-pathway marker-outcome family from execution while retaining all candidates in the master registry.

model.interpretation: association-based indirect-effect analysis; not causal mediation
model.outcome_orientation: All clinical outcomes are transformed so higher values indicate worse status.
model.path_a: M_z ~ X_z + age_at_imaging_z + sex_binary + PTEDUCAT_z + PC1_z-PC10_z + SITE + COLPROT + batch + ICV_z (sMRI only)
model.path_b_and_direct: Y_future_z ~ M_z + X_z + Y_baseline_z + exact_followup_days_z + age_at_imaging_z + sex_binary + PTEDUCAT_z + PC1_z-PC10_z + SITE + COLPROT + batch + ICV_z (sMRI only)
model.standardization: Continuous exposure, mediator, outcome, and continuous covariates are z-scored within each complete-case candidate sample; categorical indicators are not standardized.
model.indirect_effect: standardized path_a multiplied by standardized path_b
model.bootstrap_two_sided_p: twice the smaller sign-tail probability with a plus-one finite-sample correction

multiplicity.supplemental_family_definition: eight imaging markers within one pathway-outcome family
multiplicity.excluded_candidate_handling: Untested candidates remain in the fixed multiplicity denominator and are treated as P=1 for adjustment.

sensitivity_analyses_outside_master_regi: tau PVC markers corresponding to the two primary non-PVC tau markers
APOE-region-excluded pathway PRS after separate score construction and freeze
721-subject six-array cohort after successful post-imputation harmonization
